highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: 21st September – Threat Intelligence Report and AI intelligence report falsely identifies weapons on Chinese ship, nearly triggers US military operation. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Transparent Tribe targets India, Afghanistan with new malware in Operation RapidRust. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: ShinyHunters defaces Clop ransomware data leak site, claims data theft. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
